heading: Content settings
intro: Change how the platform works without a new release. Changes apply within a minute, and each one is logged with who, what, when and the before and after values.
auditLink: See every settings change in the audit log
saved: Saved. It applies within a minute.

failures.not_allowed: Only the owner and admins can change settings.
failures.not_found: That setting no longer exists. Reload the page.
failures.unreachable: We couldn't reach the database. Check your connection and try again.

reasons.wrong_kind: The new value must be the same kind as the old one (a number stays a number).
reasons.bad_item: Each item must be a word or a number of zero or more.
reasons.repeated_item: Each item may appear only once.
reasons.changed_parts: The value must keep all its parts.
reasons.typed_invalid: Type a number of zero or more, or a list separated by a comma and a space.
reasons.no_moderator: No moderator who reads this language is on the rota yet. Record the languages staff read on Staff › Roles first.
reasons.interface_language: The interface is in this language, so it stays open.
reasons.legal_check_not_done: This market's legal check isn't done yet.
reasons.owner_only: Only the owner opens a market.
reasons.no_open_language: None of this market's languages is open yet.

flags.intro: Flags let us switch something on later without new code. Each switch saves at once.

invite_only.label: Sign-up by invitation only
invite_only.description: People can only join with an invite link (the March test).

adults_only.label: Adults only
adults_only.description: Only people 18 or over can join, and they are active without the age check (the March test).

social_login.label: Sign in with Google, Apple or Microsoft
social_login.description: Shows the three sign-in buttons. Leave it off until each provider is set up.

maintenance_mode.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance_mode.description: When on, everyone except staff sees the maintenance page.

picture_uploads.label: Picture uploads
picture_uploads.description: Covers and profile pictures. Every picture goes through the picture check first. Leave it off until the picture check's services are connected.

values.intro: Counts, limits, hours and weights the platform reads each time it needs them.
values.listHint: Separate items with a comma and a space.

names.ai_label_confirmed_reports: Confirmed AI reports before a label
names.ranking_weight_read_through: Weight of reading to the end
names.ranking_half_life_days: Days until a signal counts half
names.rising_writer_days: A writer counts as rising for (days)
names.new_account_hours: An account counts as new for (hours)
names.comment_hourly_limit_new_account: Comments an hour for a new account
names.comment_new_account_hours: Hours a new account's comments are limited
names.new_account_max_links: Links in one comment from a new account
names.reporting_pause_days: Days reporting is paused after misuse
names.downvote_new_account_hours: Hours before a new account can downvote
names.sign_in_pause_tries: Wrong log-in tries before a pause
names.case_claim_minutes: A claimed case is released after (minutes)
names.on_call_escalation_minutes: Minutes before an on-call alert goes to the next person
names.safety_contact_warning_days: Days before an unchecked safety contact shows a warning
names.staff_fresh_sign_in_minutes: Minutes a fresh staff sign-in counts
names.removal_order_preserve_months: Content removed by an order is preserved for (months)
names.rank_badge_min_stories: Rank badges: fewest stories a tag needs before a cover shows a rank in it

discover.intro: The shelves on Discover and their order. Sponsors can't change this.

rateLimits.intro: How many times an hour an account may do each action. New accounts get tighter limits for their first hours (see "An account counts as new for" above). Comments and reports have their own limits above.

categories.intro: The order readers see on the new story form and on Discover. A new category arrives in a release, with its name in both languages.

names.intro: Nobody can take these as a username or pen name. Look-alikes such as "adm1n" are blocked too. Names the platform itself uses stay reserved.

words.intro: Words a username or pen name may not contain, in each language.
words.empty: No word on this list matches.

markets.intro: Romania opens first. Other countries open later, one by one, each after its legal check. A language opens only when moderators who read it are on the rota.
markets.languagesNote: Writers pick a story's language from the open ones; the others show as "coming when we have moderators for it". The interface stays in English and Română.
markets.marketsNote: A market opens only when its legal check is done and at least one of its languages is open. Only the owner opens a market. The market comes from the country of the connection, kept as a country code only, never the IP address.
